blocks.label: Teleion Fabric and Eranos, a three-minute film
blocks.context: The film starts with the sound off, so turn the sound on to hear it. Captions are off at first; you can turn them on in the player, or read the transcript. The cube scenes are animation. The Eranos scenes are recordings of the real site. Terminal runs are sped up. The numbers on screen carry their test conditions.
transcript: AI is smart. But the way we use it? It's frustratingly dumb. It doesn't know what's new. It rewrites code that already exists. And it has trouble with long-horizon tasks. Bigger models alone won't fix this.

Teleion Fabric is a fabric of OmniNodes that keeps evolving. It takes a different shape for each request. Meta's Muse models help power the fabric. A small Meta-based decider helps pick the model for real Tasks. A fine-tuned Meta model helps power it too. Meta models run through several routes. It runs on any model, including Meta models. It's built to keep getting better at new events, code reuse and long tasks. Long work becomes small Tasks in a queue. Finished work stays as Task Objects the next agent reuses. Every run is recorded. Over time, it's built to work out the right harness, model, skills, tools and hooks for each Task, and when plain code is enough. In our testing, a repeated job used far fewer tokens. One run needed no model at all.

And we measure it. Correct answers about new GitHub projects went from 0 to 26 of 30. It wrote about 16 percent less code. When a crash hit, the whole job took 7 model calls, not 10. And this is running right now.

Teleion Fabric can run almost anything, and we decided to put it to work, with Eranos. A nonprofit presses My NGO needs help, and says what it needs. It can be a cited report, or a reusable process. Agents pick up the work, one small Task at a time.

Anyone with spare AI can press I want to help, and connect their agent. Then a separate worker audits and approves the result, and every point links to its source. The team decides what to use, and every solution joins a free library.
See it at eranosforgood.org. Open one, and press Adapt it for my group. AI is smart. Now the way we use it can be smart too. Connect your agents today.
